name: Banish the Dark
body:
The energy you channel carries within it the light capable of banishing even the deepest shadows.

Prerequisite(s): Channel positive energy 5d6, worshiper of a deity of the sun.

Benefit(s): When you channel positive energy, you can spend two daily uses of that ability to dispel all spells belonging to the shadow subschool, or with the darkness or shadow descriptors, inside the range of your channel. This works like dispel magic, and you make a single caster level check using your character level as your caster level and compare its result to the DC of every affected spell.
